corrections.name: UParTAK4_kinfit
corrections.description: UParTAK4_kinfit scale factors for 2024_Summer24 for b/c jets in fixedWP b-tagging. Uncertainties are provided in a broken-down format and consist of 'fsrdef/isrdef/hdamp/jer/jes/mass/tune/statistic'. All but the 'statistic' uncertainty are to be correlated with b-tagging SF uncertainties from other eras if possible
